content:
Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Setting Up and Navigating SQL Environment
    - Lesson 3: Basic SQL Data Manipulation (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
    - Lesson 4: Querying Tables with SELECT Statement
    - Lesson 5: Filtering Results with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 6: Sorting and Ordering with ORDER BY Clause
    - Lesson 7: Joins: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, OUTER JOIN
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Querying Techniques: UNION, DISTINCT
    - Lesson 9: Working with NULL values and aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
    - Lesson 10: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses

   Track: Data Cleaning with Python
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Data Types and Handling Missing Values in Pandas
    - Lesson 2: Reading, Writing, and Manipulating CSV Files
    - Lesson 3: Merging, Joining, and Concatenating DataFrames
    - Lesson 4: Renaming Columns and Rearranging Columns with Dropping and Moving
    - Lesson 5: Handling Duplicate Rows in DataFrames
    - Lesson 6: Data Filtering with Boolean Indexing
    - Lesson 7: Data Visualization using Seaborn library
    - Lesson 8: Time Series Analysis and Resampling Data with Pandas Timestamp

   Track: Intermediate SQL
    - Lesson 1: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 2: Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK)
    - Lesson 3: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and Recursive Queries
    - Lesson 4: Handling Complex Data Types with JSON and XML
    - Lesson 5: Views and Synonyms
    - Lesson 6: Database Indexing for Performance Optimization
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Transaction Control Statements (BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK)
    - Lesson 8: Security Best Practices: Access Control and Auditing

   Track: Data Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 1: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and Descriptive Statistics with Pandas
    - Lesson 2: Correlation Matrices and Heatmaps
    - Lesson 3: Hypothesis Testing with T-test and ANOVA
    - Lesson 4: Regression Analysis using Linear Regression
    - Lesson 5: Clustering Data Using KMeans
    - Lesson 6: Decision Trees and Random Forests
    - Lesson 7: Machine Learning Model Evaluation (Cross-Validation, ROC Curve)
    - Lesson 8: Predictive Modeling with Time Series Analysis

   Track: Data Manipulation with SQL
    - Lesson 1: Stored Procedures and Triggers
    - Lesson 2: Cascading Updates using ON UPDATE CASCADE
    - Lesson 3: Referential Integrity and Foreign Keys
    - Lesson 4: Using Transactions for Data Consistency
    - Lesson 5: Database Normalization Techniques (1st, 2nd, 3rd)
    - Lesson 6: Creating Views with Joined Tables
    - Lesson 7: Advanced SQL Queries with CASE WHEN and COALESCE
    - Lesson 8: Query Optimization and Index Strategies

   Track: Data Presentation with Python (Optional)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Dash library for Interactive Dashboards
    - Lesson 2: Building Basic Dashboards with Input Components
    - Lesson 3: Using Graphs, Plots, and Charts in Dash
    - Lesson 4: Advanced Interactivity and Event Handling in Dash
    - Lesson 5: Deploying Your Dashboards on Web Servers (Heroku, AWS)
    - Lesson 6: Collaboration and Sharing your Dashboards with GitHub
    - Lesson 7: Data Security and Access Control for Dashboards
    - Lesson 8: Building Real-World Case Study Dashboards
